evidence_source: Results supplied by the repository owner from the Colab notebook; original GPU artifacts have not been independently inspected

generated_response_evaluation.rating_process: Model identities hidden during comparison; AI suggested ratings and reasons which the owner saved. Not independent human evaluation.
generated_response_evaluation.note: Prompt bootstrap; does not capture rater bias or disagreement.

limitations: Eight comparisons and one training seed do not support a broad alignment claim.
Several displayed responses were identical and several ended mid-sentence at the generation limit.
Some responses refused benign requests or introduced unsupported harmful-content allegations.
Validation selected step 1; final-step metrics describe a different checkpoint.
Original dataset manifest, adapter provenance, ratings file, and comparison mapping still need archival verification.
conclusion: This pilot did not demonstrate improved generated-response quality from DPO.
